notes:
1. Dek says "Customers Bank reports a loan process cut to seven days". Source: "a pilot of its AI loan closing process closed select commercial loans in seven days, compared with the typical 30 to 60 days." Fix: say a pilot closed select commercial loans in seven days, e.g. "Customers Bank says an AI pilot closed select commercial loans in seven days while Citi and OpenAI hold back where access is the risk."
2. Section 2 opens "Where the bank does want speed, the numbers are concrete." Right after the Citi section, "the bank" reads as Citi, and no source says Customers Bank "wants speed" or that its numbers are "concrete". Fix: "Customers Bank offers the other side." or similar, naming Customers Bank and dropping "does want speed" and "the numbers are concrete".
3. Section 3 says "OpenAI made a similar call about its own work". Source: OpenAI "will train its models using cached copies and simulated versions of the internet instead of the live web because the models are too unpredictable to be trusted with live internet access." That is model training, not Citi's decision on agent access, so "similar" is the desk's claim. Fix: "OpenAI also holds back on live access, saying on Friday it will train its models using..."
4. Section 4 heading "Accountability stays with people" states a fact. Source: Solomon wrote the principles "could be applied to artificial intelligence oversight". Fix: a heading that keeps it a proposal, e.g. "Solomon wants accountability to sit with people".
5. Title "Banks pick where to move fast with AI and where to wait": OpenAI is not a bank and no source shows banks "picking" this. Fix: e.g. "Where AI moves fast and where it waits".
6. Section 5 asks "which steps could take the seven-day route". Source: only "select commercial loans" in a pilot closed in seven days. Fix: "which steps could be sped up the way Customers Bank's pilot sped up select loans".
7. Brief 2026-10-24-citi-cautious-ai-agent-access, note says "Citi's remark sits alongside the wider bank moves to restrict outside agents". The source (title and quote only) says nothing about wider bank moves. This note is printed in the email. Fix: delete the clause, e.g. "Anwar's remark is a statement of caution about agent access."
